description.en: Inverted the ratio, computing applied stress divided by yield strength instead of the other way round.
description.et: Pööras suhte ümber, arvutades rakenduva pinge jagatuna voolavuspiiriga, selle asemel et teha vastupidi.

description.en: Subtracted the applied stress from the yield strength instead of dividing one by the other.
description.et: Lahutas rakenduva pinge voolavuspiirist, selle asemel et üht teisega jagada.

description.en: Used the applied stress alone as if it were already the factor of safety, ignoring the material's yield strength entirely.
description.et: Kasutas rakenduvat pinget üksi, nagu see oleks juba varutegur, jättes materjali voolavuspiiri täielikult arvestamata.
